title: An E exchange has a constructible integral model
statement: Use the coefficient construction [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Fix prime ℓ, finite normed E/ℚ_ℓ, and a Cartesian square of separated finite-type schemes over a field k of positive prime characteristic different from ℓ, with proper f:X→Y and all maps over k. For every bounded constructible complex K of continuous E coefficient internal modules on X there is a bounded constructible integral complex M on X such that the image under integralScalarExtension on Y′ of its specified integral base-change component is isomorphic, as an arrow of the full E derived category on Y′, to the specified continuous E base-change component at K. No invertibility of either exchange component is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13 and Proposition 6.8.14(2), integral lattices and rationalization; exchange compatibility in the condensed realization argument

proof.text: The finite-type k-scheme X is Noetherian. Apply continuousConstructible_integral_model to K, obtaining a bounded constructible integral M and an actual E-realization isomorphism e. Exact scalar extension preserves bounded constructibility, so lift e to the full bounded constructible category.

For the Cartesian proper square apply continuousIntegral_exchange_square to M. This supplies isomorphisms s,t of the actual exchange endpoints and the commuting equation for scalar extension of the integral exchange and the E exchange at the realization of M.

Map the realization isomorphism e through the source and target functors of the E exchange and then through the full derived-category inclusion. Compose these endpoint isomorphisms with s,t. Naturality of the specified E exchange at e, combined with the commuting equation by associativity, gives exactly the relation required by Arrow.isoMk. Package this arrow isomorphism together with M.

proof_origin.note: A2: Lean now constructs the final Arrow isomorphism by the canonical endpoint comparisons and naturality. The new model, localization, and coherence nodes isolate the separate steps. Integral scalar exactness and the formal mate argument are proved in this delivery.

theorem continuousExchange_integral_model [IsProper f]
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : ProEtale.BoundedConstructible
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)) :
    ∃ M : ProEtale.BoundedConstructible (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X),
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((integralScalarExtension ℓ E Y').map
          ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (sq.toCommSq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app M).hom) ≅
        Arrow.mk ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (sq.toCommSq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app K).hom)
